shelters.name: PAWS Chicago
shelters.description: National model in animal sheltering, committed to ending the killing of homeless cats and dogs. One of the largest no-kill shelters in the Midwest.

shelters.name: Anti-Cruelty Society
shelters.description: Founded 1899, Chicago's oldest and largest private, open-admission, unlimited stay humane society. One of the largest in the US. Offers spay/neuter clinic, humane education, cruelty investigation.

shelters.name: Wright-Way Rescue
shelters.description: 501(c)(3) nonprofit animal adoption center. In 2024, rescued 4,524 dogs and cats. Offers adoption and community education.

shelters.name: South Suburban Humane Society
shelters.description: Finding homes and providing resources for pets in Chicago's south suburbs for over 50 years. Includes adoption center, resource center, low-cost vet clinic, and spay/neuter clinic.

shelters.name: Chicago Animal Care and Control
shelters.description: Protects public safety and ensures humane care of animals through sheltering, pet placement, education and animal law enforcement for the City of Chicago.

shelters.name: Friends of Chicago Animal Care and Control
shelters.description: Nonprofit committed exclusively to helping save lives of over 19,000 animals that come into custody of Chicago Animal Care and Control each year.

shelters.name: A.R.F. - Animal Rescue Foundation
shelters.description: 501(c)(3) no-kill humane society with volunteers dedicated to rescuing, fostering, and rehoming dogs and cats.

shelters.name: One Tail at a Time
shelters.description: Progressive dog, cat, rabbit, and guinea pig foster and adoption program supporting under-resourced animal shelters and pet families.

shelters.name: Community Animal Rescue Effort (C.A.R.E.)
shelters.description: Volunteer-driven nonprofit dedicated to rescuing, rehabilitating, and rehoming pets in need while reducing pet overpopulation.

shelters.name: Hinsdale Humane Society
shelters.description: Private nonprofit operating Tuthill Family Pet Rescue & Resource Center, providing innovative care and adoption for all animals including those harder to place.

shelters.name: Naperville Area Humane Society
shelters.description: 501(c)(3) nonprofit limited admission animal shelter for dog and cat adoption, foster care, and owner surrenders serving western Chicago suburbs.

shelters.name: Animal Welfare League
shelters.description: Serves cats, dogs, rabbits and small pets in Chicago Ridge and surrounding southwest suburbs.

shelters.name: Illinois Humane
shelters.description: 501(c)(3) nonprofit providing medical and behavioral rehabilitation and placement for animals that are victims of human neglect and cruelty cases.

shelters.name: Animal Protective League
shelters.description: Animal shelter serving Springfield and the surrounding central Illinois area with adoption services.

shelters.name: Champaign County Humane Society
shelters.description: Provides shelter, medical, and adoption services for animals, prevents animal cruelty, and offers education programs. Best Friends Animal Society partner.

shelters.name: Humane Society of Central Illinois
shelters.description: Cares for and provides adoption services for animals in Bloomington-Normal and surrounding central Illinois areas.

shelters.name: TAPS - Tazewell Animal Protective Society
shelters.description: No-kill animal shelter providing homes for dogs, cats, puppies, and kittens until permanent homes found. Serves central Illinois area near Peoria.

shelters.name: Peoria County Animal Protection Services
shelters.description: Serves every municipality in Peoria County. Enforces animal control ordinances, maintains rabies records, operates open admission shelter.

shelters.name: Winnebago County Animal Services
shelters.description: Community leader and credible resource for safety awareness through enforcement and education, fostering the human-animal bond.

shelters.name: Wish Bone Canine Rescue
shelters.description: Not-for-profit, no-kill canine rescue in central Illinois. Rescues and rehomes over 750 dogs annually, provides low-cost vaccination and spay/neuter clinics.

shelters.name: West Suburban Humane Society
shelters.description: Serving DuPage County and western suburbs with animal shelter and adoption services.

shelters.name: Red Door Animal Shelter
shelters.description: No-kill shelter for cats, dogs, and rabbits in Chicago.

shelters.name: Tree House Animal Foundation
shelters.description: Cat-only rescue and adoption organization serving Chicago with cageless sheltering approach.

shelters.name: DuPage County Animal Services
shelters.description: DuPage County government animal services providing shelter and adoption services for the county.

shelters.name: Anderson Animal Shelter
shelters.description: One of Illinois' largest animal shelters serving the Fox Valley and greater Chicago area with adoption services.

notes: Comprehensive collection of Illinois animal shelters, humane societies, and rescue organizations. Anti-Cruelty Society (founded 1899) is Chicago's oldest and largest private humane society. PAWS Chicago is a national model in no-kill sheltering. Coverage spans Chicago and suburbs (Cook, DuPage, Lake counties), Springfield, Champaign-Urbana, Bloomington-Normal, Peoria, and Rockford.
